label: Three omission scopes of giving are strictly ordered; necessary production excludes total refraining
paraphrase: Analyst formulation on the shared causality frame, recipients individuated by provenance with rigid beings (EFFECT_INDIVIDUATION_1 of 1cb16a7f; under role individuation a replacement is no omission). For every frame, world w and being g: giving-level total refraining (TOTAL_REFRAINING_1: at some accessible world where g exists it gives nothing) implies withholding the whole actual roster (at some accessible world where g exists it gives none of the beings it gives at w, replacements allowed), which implies withholding each actual recipient individually (possibly at different worlds); a source that gives something at every accessible world where it exists never refrains totally in that giving-level sense; a fixed giver existing at w gives each of its recipients at w at every accessible world where it exists. Strictness controls: Van Cleve's frame with a giver withholds each recipient but not the whole roster and is necessarily productive; the replacement frame (g gives c at false and d at true) withholds the whole actual roster, does not totally refrain, is necessarily productive and satisfies #1897's ActualAbsenceByWithholding; the theist surrogate totally refrains. The registered STIT decision-frame controls are included: in pointwiseNotJoint each single recipient can be ensured absent while no cell omits all creation; in tiedNoEmptyChoice only optional recipient 1 is ensured absent, recipient 0 being created in every cell, and no cell omits all creation. Finite surrogates only; compare DISAMB-BOUNDED-OMISSION for world-population omission.
